data.name: Everest Carbon
data.description: Everest Carbon is a San Francisco- and Linz, Austria-based company that develops an in-field alkalinity sensor ("Pulsar") for Enhanced Rock Weathering MRV. Founded in late 2022 as an ERW project developer, it pivoted in January 2024 to commercialize its patent-pending ion-exchange-resin sensor that measures carbonate alkalinity efflux directly in soil, targeting a 90% reduction in MRV costs. The company raised $3M led by Carbon Removal Partners and has hundreds of sensors deployed at ERW projects worldwide.
